## Load data

Analysis dataset
```{r}
load('RData/Analysis_dataset.RData')
```


Analysis of BUN data stratified by age group and coma status

```{r}
sm_data_bun = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(BUN))
f_brm_mod_bun = as.formula(bf(Died_28D ~ s(log10(BUN),by=Age_category)+Coma+(1|STUDY/SITE_STUDY)))

f_path = 'RData/bun_models.RData'
RUN_STAN_MODELS=F
if(!file.exists(f_path) | RUN_STAN_MODELS){
  mod_bun_age_het = 
    brm(formula = f_brm_mod_bun,
        data = sm_data_bun ,
        family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
        iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 1, refresh = 250)
  
  mod_bun_age_het2 = 
    brm(formula = f_brm_mod_bun,
        data = sm_data_bun %>% filter(STUDY!='TRACT'),
        family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
        iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 1, refresh = 250)
  
  mod_bun_age_het3 = 
    brm(formula = f_brm_mod_bun,
        data = sm_data_bun %>% filter(PfHRP2_ng_ml > 800),
        family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
        iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 1, refresh = 250)

  save(mod_bun_age_het,mod_bun_age_het2,mod_bun_age_het3, file = f_path)
} else {
  load(f_path)
}
```



```{r}
k_vals=40
test_data = expand_grid(BUN = 10^seq(0.2,1.6,length.out=k_vals),
                        Age_category=levels(sm_data_bun$Age_category),
                        Weight_category=levels(sm_data_bun$Weight_category),
                        Coma=unique(sm_data_bun$Coma),
                        STUDY=unique(sm_data_bun$STUDY), 
                        SITE_STUDY = -1) %>% 
  arrange(BUN)

# remove non plausible combinations
test_data = test_data %>%
  filter(!(Age_category==">15" & Weight_category=='(0,25]'),
         !(Age_category %in% c("(2,5]","≤2") & Weight_category=='(25,100]')) %>%
  mutate(Age_category=factor(Age_category, levels = c("≤2","(2,5]","(5,15]",">15")))

# get model predictions
# Full model
preds = posterior_epred(mod_bun_age_het, newdata = test_data, re_formula = NA)
test_data$pred_mod_bun_age_het = colMeans(preds)
test_data$bun_age_het_threshold = apply(preds, 2, f_threshold,mortality_threshold=mortality_threshold)

# High HRP2 model
test_data3 = test_data %>% filter(Age_category !='>15') %>% mutate(Age_category = droplevels(Age_category))
preds = posterior_epred(mod_bun_age_het3, newdata = test_data3, re_formula = NA)
test_data3$pred_mod_bun_age_het3 = colMeans(preds)
test_data3$bun_age_het_threshold3 = apply(preds, 2, f_threshold,mortality_threshold=mortality_threshold)
```



```{r age_vs_BUN, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
p1=test_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUN, y = pred_mod_bun_age_het, 
             colour = Age_category,linetype = Coma,
             group = interaction(Age_category,Coma)))+
  geom_line()+ ylab('Predicted mortality')+
  scale_x_log10() +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  xlab('Urea Nitrogen (mmol/L)')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)
p1_threshold=test_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUN, y = bun_age_het_threshold, 
             colour = Age_category,linetype = Coma,
             group = interaction(Age_category,Coma)))+
  geom_line()+ylab('Probability mortality > 5%')+
  scale_x_log10() + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+
  xlab('Urea Nitrogen (mmol/L)')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = .95)+geom_vline(xintercept = 10)
grid.arrange(p1, p1_threshold)
```
